data.name: EVP_EmperorsWrath_DESC
data.value: Power! Unlimited Power! You fry your enemies with a stream of electrical energy You may fire one ray, plus one additional ray for every four levels beyond 3rd (to a maximum of three rays at 11th level). Each ray requires a ranged touch attack to hit and deals 4d6 points of fire damage.

data.name: EVP_FrostBlast_DESC
data.value: You blast your enemies with a torrent of cold energy. You may fire one ray, plus one additional ray for every four levels beyond 3rd (to a maximum of three rays at 11th level). Each ray requires a ranged touch attack to hit and deals 4d6 points of fire damage.

data.name: EVP_CAUSTIC_BEAM_DESC
data.value: Acid Arrow is as much of a disappointment as you are to your parents, so I present to you: Caustic Beam! You blast your enemies with a ray of acid. You may fire one ray, plus one additional ray for every four levels beyond 3rd (to a maximum of three rays at 11th level). Each ray requires a ranged touch attack to hit and deals 4d6 points of acid damage.

data.name: EVP_BoneSpike_DESC
data.value: A spike of bone forms from the other side and mercilessly strikes your target, dealing 1d4+1 points of unholy damage. The spike strikes unerringly, even if the target is in melee combat, so long as it has less than total cover or total concealment. Specific parts of a creature can't be singled out. Objects are not damaged by the spell. For every two caster levels beyond 1st, you gain an additional spike – two at 3rd level, three at 5th, four at 7th, and the maximum of eight spikes at 15th level or higher.

data.name: EVP_ACID_MISSILE_DESC
data.value: A mass of acid forms and violently strikes your target, dealing 1d4+1 points of acid damage. The missile strikes unerringly, even if the target is in melee combat, so long as it has less than total cover or total concealment. Specific parts of a creature can't be singled out. Objects are not damaged by the spell. For every two caster levels beyond 1st, you gain an additional missile – two at 3rd level, three at 5th, four at 7th, and the maximum of five missiles at 9th level or higher.

data.name: EVP_FIRE_MISSILE_DESC
data.value: A blazing bolt of fire forms and violently strikes your target, dealing 1d4+1 points of fire damage. The missile strikes unerringly, even if the target is in melee combat, so long as it has less than total cover or total concealment. Specific parts of a creature can't be singled out. Objects are not damaged by the spell. For every two caster levels beyond 1st, you gain an additional missile – two at 3rd level, three at 5th, four at 7th, and the maximum of five missiles at 9th level or higher.

data.name: EVP_ELECTRIC_MISSILE_DESC
data.value: A crackling surge of electricity forms and violently strikes your target, dealing 1d4+1 points of electricity damage. The missile strikes unerringly, even if the target is in melee combat, so long as it has less than total cover or total concealment. Specific parts of a creature can't be singled out. Objects are not damaged by the spell. For every two caster levels beyond 1st, you gain an additional missile – two at 3rd level, three at 5th, four at 7th, and the maximum of five missiles at 9th level or higher.

data.name: EVP_ICE_MISSILE_DESC
data.value: A shard of freezing ice forms and violently strikes your target, dealing 1d4+1 points of cold damage. The missile strikes unerringly, even if the target is in melee combat, so long as it has less than total cover or total concealment. Specific parts of a creature can't be singled out. Objects are not damaged by the spell. For every two caster levels beyond 1st, you gain an additional missile – two at 3rd level, three at 5th, four at 7th, and the maximum of five missiles at 9th level or higher.

data.name: EVP_VitriolicBurst_DESC
data.value: A vitriolic mass forms in front of you and is sent flying. When it lands the caustic energy explodes and deals 1d6 points of acid damage per caster level (maximum 10d6) to every creature within the area. A successful Reflex save halves this damage.

data.name: EVP_CorpseExplosion_DESC
data.value: Recycling is very important to Necromancers. Since the fallen foe or friend no longer needs their body, why not put it to use. This spell causes a corpse to explode with a 15 foot radius, causing d8 unholy energy damage per caster level.

data.name: EVP_EldritchHorror_DESC
data.value: A small part of a terrifying existence from beyond, creeps from the ground to ensnare and strangle your enemies. Creatures that fail their save are entangled and receive 2d4 unholy damage plus 1d4 for every 2 levels beyond 5th.

data.name: EVP_HELL_ON_EARTH_DESC
data.value: You summon Hell itself to assault your enemies. Arms of the dead burst from the ground to ensnare and rip apart your enemies. Creatures that fail their save receive 1d12 unholy damage per caster level.

data.name: EVP_NECROMANCER_DESC
data.value: A sorcerer who rejects traditional bloodlines and draws power from death itself.

data.name: EVP_NECRO_FOCUS_DESC
data.value: Choose which class specific bonus you want.

data.name: EVP_NECRO_BONE_ARMOR_DESC
data.value: Bones surround you and form a defensive layer adding +1 to your AC. You gain an additional +1 every four levels past 1 for a total of +5 at 17th level.

data.name: EVP_NECRO_BONEARMOR_BONUS_DESC
data.value: A silent ward of bone encases you, unseen yet unyielding. Necromantic energies constantly reinforce your form, shaping a skeletal mantle that protects you without effort or command. Grants scaling natural armor. +1 AC at first level and +1 every four levels afterwards.

data.name: EVP_MASTER_OF_DEATH_DESC
data.value: Your natural affinity to the realm of Death grows with your power. Necromancy school spells gain +1 damage per die, a +2 bonus per die at 9th level and increasing to a +3 bonus per die at 17th level.

data.name: EVP_HARBINGER_OF_BOOM_DESC
data.value: Your penchant for devastation let's you add your charisma bonus to all Evocation school spells. Unfortunately due to this single-minded focus on kinetic power, you can no longer learn spells from any school besides evocation and conjuration.

data.name: EVP_UNDEAD_BLOODLINE_DESC
data.value: Death answers your call not as a distant mystery, but as a patient ally. The chill of the grave clings to your soul, and the whispers of departed spirits guide your hand. Your magic does not merely mimic decay—it commands it, shaping negative energy into weapon and ward alike. Bonus feats include: Combat Casting, Great Fortitude, Iron Will, Skill Focus - Lore (Religion), Spell Focus, Greater Spell Focus, Toughness, Diehard.

data.name: EVP_WitheringRay_DESC
data.value: Starting at 1st level, you can unleash a withering ray as a standard action, targeting any foe within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack. This ray destroys life energy, dealing 1 damage die of negative energy damage + 1 damage die for every two sorcerer levels you possess beyond first. The damage die is d6 initially and increases to d8 at 8th level, d10 at 14th level, and d12 at 18th level. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. This ability is granted the +1 per die bonus of the Master of Death feature.

data.name: EVP_DeathRay_DESC
data.value: You fire a ray of deathly energy. Make a ranged touch attack. On a hit, the ray deals 4d6 negative energy damage plus an additional ray for every four levels beyond 3rd (to a maximum of 3 rays at 11th level)..

data.name: EVP_EVOKER_DESC
data.value: An Evoker is a living conduit of raw, untamed power, channeling the pure forces of flame, frost, lightning, and acid into devastating spells. Rejecting illusions, enchantments, and subtle arts, he devotes himself entirely to evocation—magic meant to shatter, scorch, and annihilate. Every incantation is honed for maximum impact, turning battlefields into blazing craters and storm-wracked ruins. Where others seek versatility, he seeks only overwhelming destructive supremacy.

data.name: EVP_EVOKER_BLOODLINE_DESC
data.value: Select an evoker bloodline. Unlike other sorcerers, evokers channel their power through a narrow set of destructive traditions.

data.name: EVP_EVOKER_ARCANE_DESC
data.value: Your blood hums with raw arcane resonance. Unlike elemental specialists, you draw upon the fundamental weave itself, shaping pure magical force into devastating expressions of power. Where others command flame or storm, you command magic in its most primal and unrefined form.

data.name: EVP_EVOKER_AIR_DESC
data.value: The sky answers your call. Lightning dances at your fingertips and thunder rolls in your wake. Swift, untamed, and relentless, your magic strikes like a tempest—sudden as a gale and devastating as a storm that shatters the battlefield in blinding arcs of power.

data.name: EVP_EVOKER_EARTH_DESC
data.value: Your power manifests as virulent acid and caustic corruption, eating through armor, stone, and flesh with terrifying speed. Where others rely on brute force, you dissolve resistance itself—your magic hissing and spitting as it melts defenses into ruin. Swift, corrosive, and merciless, your spells reduce even the strongest opponents to a mere puddle.

data.name: EVP_EVOKER_FIRE_DESC
data.value: Flame is your birthright. You conjure infernos that consume steel and flesh alike, and your magic burns with unrestrained intensity. Whether as a focused lance of searing heat or a roaring conflagration, your power leaves only ash and cinders in its wake.

data.name: EVP_EVOKER_WATER_DESC
data.value: Winter answers your call. Frost gathers along your skin and the air stills in your presence as you command biting cold and relentless ice. Your magic does not crash like a wave—it encases, slows, and preserves in crystal silence before shattering foes in a storm of rime and splintered frost.

data.name: EVP_EVOKER_SCALING_FIRE_DESC
data.value: Your flames burn with escalating fury. Your spells that deal fire damage gain +1 damage per die per rank. Ranks increase at levels 1, 5, 9, 13, and 17.

data.name: EVP_EVOKER_SCALING_WATER_DESC
data.value: Your mastery of frost deepens with experience. Your spells that deal cold damage gain +1 damage per die per rank. Ranks increase at levels 1, 5, 9, 13, and 17.

data.name: EVP_EVOKER_SCALING_AIR_DESC
data.value: You channel the growing wrath of the storm. Your spells that deal electricity damage gain +1 damage per die per rank. Ranks increase at levels 1, 5, 9, 13, and 17.

data.name: EVP_EVOKER_SCALING_EARTH_DESC
data.value: Your corrosive magic intensifies with each milestone. Your spells that deal acid damage gain +1 damage per die per rank. Ranks increase at levels 1, 5, 9, 13, and 17.

data.name: EVP_EVOKER_SCALING_ARCANE_DESC
data.value: Your grasp of arcane structure refines your destructive spells. You gain a +2 bonus to the Difficulty Class of your Evocation spells per rank. This bonus stacks with Spell Focus. Ranks increase at levels 1, 5, 9, 13, and 17.

data.name: EVP_FORCE_BEAM_DESC
data.value: You unleash a concentrated beam of pure arcane force. This ray deals 1d4 points of force damage +1 for every 2 sorcerer levels.

data.name: EVP_FORCE_RAY_DESC
data.value: You blast your enemies with a ray of pure force energy. You may fire one ray, plus one additional ray for every four levels beyond 3rd (to a maximum of three rays at 11th level). Each ray requires a ranged touch attack to hit and deals 4d4 points of force damage.

data.name: EVP_PROTECTION_FROM_ENERGY_COMMUNAL_DESC
data.value: At 8th level, you add Protection from Energy, Communal to your list of spells known as a 4th-level sorcerer spell.

data.name: EVP_ARCANE_FORCE_BLAST_DESC
data.value: At 9th level, you can unleash a blast of elemental power once per day. This 20-foot-radius burst does 1d6 points of force damage per sorcerer level. Those caught in the area of your blast receive a Reflex save for half damage. Creatures that fail their saves gain vulnerability to your energy type until the end of your next turn. The DC of this save is equal to 10 + 1/2 your sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier. At 9th level, you can use this ability once per day. At 17th level, you can use this ability twice per day. At 20th level, you can use this ability three times per day. This power has a range of 60 feet.

data.name: EVP_NECRO_FAMILIAR_DESC
data.value: You gain a familiar that functions as an extension of your will. This companion progresses with your sorcerer level.

data.name: EVP_MAXIMUS_COMPANION_DESC
data.value: The best kitty ever! I added him in memory of my late cat. He will always remain in our hearts. Only pick this pet if you want excellence, as no other pet can compare to Sir Maximus Griswold Meowerschmidt II.
